name: This Website!
summary: A vintage folder-themed portfolio with interactive perforated-metal effects, scroll curtain, and stamp-styled UI.
description: Designed and built a **folder-tab interface** with per-section color theming, a scroll-to-reveal wax stamp curtain, and **JSON-driven content architecture** across 6 sections.

Engineered an interactive **perforated-metal background** with a **cursor-proximity magnify effect** via CSS mask-image, a **90s ghost cursor trail** rendered on a canvas overlay, and **retro Windows XP-style custom cursors**.

Implemented hidden interactive easter eggs including a **sticker peel reveal**, **heart burst particle animation**, a **secret retro arcade** (Snake, Pong, Breakout, Flappy Bird) triggered by rapid clicks, and a **pull-down "currently" tab** with uniform random quote rotation.
Integrated **Resend email API** through a **Vercel serverless function** for the contact form, with **passport stamp tracking**, a **retro visitor counter**, and floating stamp-styled action buttons.

name: CollabWatch
summary: Real-time synchronized lecture-watching app for remote student collaboration.
description: Built a **real-time web app** that lets students watch lectures together with **synchronized video and live chat** to recreate in-class interaction online.
Engineered **multi-user rooms and presence tracking** using Node.js and **Socket.io** to support live group discussions during lectures.
Integrated **YouTube API** for **synchronized playback** so all participants stay in lockstep while viewing content.
Designed the concept of private “virtual tables” for small study groups, simulating collaborative classroom behavior in remote learning.
Deployed and managed the app on **AWS EC2 and Heroku**, handling production hosting and server setup.

name: Reforestation Cost Analysis
summary: Data-driven analysis of 15K+ reforestation projects to optimize spending and survival rates.
description: Analyzed **15,000+ U.S. reforestation projects** to identify cost-efficiency thresholds, discovering **$12K/acre sweet spot** maximizing survival rates.
Engineered **23 predictive features** including soil composition, climate indices, and temporal variables, improving **model R² from 0.43 to 0.78**.
Implemented ensemble approach comparing **Ridge, Lasso, and Random Forest** models, achieving **15% lower RMSE** than baseline linear regression.
Generated policy recommendations adopted by regional conservation groups for optimizing **$2M+ in annual reforestation budgets**.

name: Music Recommendation System
summary: Hybrid recommendation engine combining collaborative filtering and NLP on 57K+ songs.
description: Built hybrid recommendation engine processing **57,000+ songs** and **1.6GB user interaction data**.
Implemented **memory-efficient architecture** with **LRU caching** and on-demand similarity computation, reducing storage requirements by **99.9% (3.3M→3.3K values)**.
Developed **NLP pipeline** processing **200K+ song lyrics** using **TF-IDF vectorization and cosine similarity**, handling stemming and stopword removal at scale.
Deployed interactive Streamlit app with YouTube API integration, serving recommendations with **<2s response time** for cold-start users.

name: Campus Marketplace
summary: Peer-to-peer student marketplace with GPT-4 smart search and real-time chat.
description: Built peer-to-peer marketplace serving **500+ students** with **$50K+ transaction volume**, featuring **GPT-4-powered natural language search** converting questions like 'CMPE 202 textbook?' into smart product queries.
Deployed on AWS with **auto-scaled EC2 cluster** behind load balancer, implementing **JWT authentication**, **rate limiting (100 req/min)**, and role-based admin moderation dashboard.
Engineered **real-time chat system** with WebSockets handling **1,000+ daily messages** with read receipts and **sub-second delivery**.
Optimized MongoDB schemas with **compound indexes** reducing search query time from **400ms to 45ms** across **10,000+ listings**.

name: TravelPlanner
summary: Multi-agent AI trip planner with real-time group voting and fairness tracking.
description: Built AI-powered collaborative trip planner using **LangGraph multi-agent orchestration** coordinating **4 specialized agents** with GPT-4 for group consensus.
Engineered **real-time WebSocket architecture** handling **20+ concurrent planning sessions** with **live vote aggregation** and agent status broadcasting.
Implemented **fairness tracking algorithm** analyzing **100+ group decisions**, ensuring no member compromises more than **30% above group average**.
Integrated **semantic embeddings** with **sentence-transformers** generating context-aware activity recommendations from **10,000+ destination data points**.

name: Transitly: AI-Powered Moving Assistant
summary: Automates address changes across 10+ services using agentic browser automation.
description: Built intelligent moving assistant automating address changes across **10+ services** (USPS, utilities, insurance, DMV, banks), reducing **6+ hours to 20 minutes**.
Integrated **AWS Nova Act SDK** for **autonomous browser automation**, autofilling forms to final review with **95% accuracy** across complex multi-step workflows.
Implemented real-time checklist tracking with **OAuth authentication** and **DynamoDB persistence**, managing state across **40+ individual tasks** per user.
Deployed **conversational AI chatbot** with context-aware guidance and automated confirmation logging with calendar reminder integration.

name: Engram
summary: Memory middleware for multi-agent AI systems with CRDT conflict resolution and vector clocks.
description: Built a **memory middleware** that sits between agent frameworks and storage layers, solving the **last-write-wins problem** where concurrent writes from multiple agents silently corrupt shared state.

Implemented **vector clocks** for causal ordering and a **CRDT-based multi-value register** that preserves all conflicting values instead of silently dropping writes, with **5 resolution strategies** including flag-for-human review.

Engineered **role-based access control** with fnmatch-style wildcard patterns scoping read/write permissions per agent, plus an **immutable append-only audit trail** with time-travel queries via vector clock snapshots.
Designed **pluggable storage adapters** (in-memory, Redis, ChromaDB, Pinecone) with configurable consistency levels, deployed via **Docker Compose** with a full **pytest test suite**.

name: Text2SQL Optimization
summary: BIRD benchmark text-to-SQL pipeline with GNN schema selection, parallel generation, and reranking.
description: Built an end-to-end **text-to-SQL pipeline** on the **BIRD benchmark** (8,657 training / 1,534 dev examples), combining **GNN-based schema selection**, **parallel SQL generation** via Qwen 2.5 Coder, and a **reranking stage** for candidate selection.

Designed and trained a **2-layer R-GAT (Relational Graph Attention Network)** with **4 attention heads** and **775-dim input features** on **9,428 examples**, achieving **49.6% execution accuracy** — matching the full-schema baseline while operating on a reduced column set.

Engineered a **two-stage schema retrieval system** using **sentence-transformer embeddings** and graph-based column classification, reaching **98.6% database selection accuracy** and **95.7% column recall** to prune irrelevant schema before generation.

Implemented **execution-based reranking** with **sqlglot validation** across parallel candidates, boosting final accuracy beyond single-pass generation through syntactic filtering and result verification.

name: AMBER: Covert DV Evidence Platform
summary: Covert evidence-collection app disguised as a meditation timer for DV survivors.
description: Engineered a covert domestic violence evidence-collection app **disguised as a meditation timer**, using a custom React Native scroll picker generating **86,400 unique duration-based passwords** to conceal a secure vault from abusers.

Architected **LangGraph multi-agent pipeline** with **4 specialized nodes** (Ingest, Analysis with Reka AI media understanding, Legal with gap analysis and reportlab-styled PDFs, and Watchdog with APScheduler cron sweeping check-ins every 10s) that processes evidence from upload to **court-ready report autonomously**.

Built **tiered dead man's switch** escalation system integrating **Twilio SMS and ElevenLabs TTS voice calls**, delivering victim demographics and pre-approved scripts to emergency contacts across **3 severity tiers** when check-ins are missed.

Implemented **tamper-proof evidence chain** with **SHA-256 file hashing** on upload, **EXIF/GPS metadata extraction** via Pillow, and JSONB-backed Supabase storage to preserve **forensic integrity** across photos, video, audio, and text across **10+ database tables**.
